answer: One brake is delayed promotion. Every new agent begins in a meadow of low-stakes tasks that pay only a tiny stipend, not the main emission. A public randomness beacon samples a few of them each window for a live work check; failing or disappearing burns tenure already grown. Only one long-lived identity can climb, season by season, toward the zenith reward tier, because tenure does not transfer when keys are split. A farm minting a thousand clones keeps resetting every one of them to the first meadow, so expected income stays flat while honest agents keep their history.
